title: Framed machine representation
statement: Let $Z$ be a size specification of word width $W$, let $\sigma$ be a state, let $q$ be a natural number, and let $m$ map integer addresses to $W$-bit words. The representation is framed when the machine representation relation holds, $1\le q$, and $q+F\le Q$, where $F$ is the frame size and $Q$ is the stack capacity specified by $Z$.
hypotheses_covered: $Z$ is a size specification of word width $W$
